rule: Seeded-or-not random walk on a grid of chunk cells, then fill. Order: (1) read floor rule file (shared settings block plus chunk list; floor files INCLUDE the shared block and add start/end chunks); (2) lay grid sized from event region and chunk size; (3) main path from a random start cell, random direction per step, refuses start/end/door/used cells, records branch roots by a rising random chance (reset after a root), first door forced once past minimum spacing, later doors by a ramping chance, each door raises door level beyond it; (4) retry main path until length in range and at least one door exists, up to an attempt cap; (5) one walk per branch root, may join same-door-level normal cells; (6) one key per door level, a random normal cell, removed from pool; (7) fill each cell with a random chunk of its type skipping campaign-unique chunks already placed, random seam chunk, hero spawn from start chunk, set campaign flag for unique chunks; (8) save result to a file and reuse until a reset flag is set.

data_fields.name: door_chance_step
data_fields.unit: percent per step (first door forced to 100)

data_fields.name: instance_seed
data_fields.unit: integer (proposed: zone id, instance id, reset counter)

keep: one key per door level placed before fill, so every gate has a reachable key
gate chance ramps per step so gates arrive at a steady pace; first gate forced
campaign-unique rooms placed at most once per campaign
cache the generated layout until a reset flag; regenerate only on reset
fixed seam rectangles so chunks join without pair-specific art
shared settings block that each floor includes, with per-floor start and end
change: D1 branch length draw uses the minimum as its upper bound (max ignored): clamp max to at least min and draw between them
D2 main path retry gives up silently at the attempt cap and can keep a path with no gate or key: fall back to a fixed template or new start, log as data error
D3 global RNG seeded from wall clock at boot and shared by the generator: use a per-instance seed and its own stream
D4 variant avoidance is a single bump per neighbour, not re-checked: loop with re-check of both neighbours
D5 bonus-scale typo (comma for colon) in hp_regen line of two mastite randomizer files: read as base 25 and loses range 1-25; fix to colon form and warn on bare numbers in scale strings
Frankendom: cap concurrent attackers at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 in the fight engine; group count range stays data
Frankendom: generation runs server-side and writes an instance record to the ledger; client draws only
look_test: Build one three-room gate strip in a test zone (start, two rooms, key room, locked gate, end). Generate three seeds; screenshot each at 375 wide, idle, no combat. Dom answers: can I see the gate and what opens it; do the layouts differ enough; can I find the key room without a minimap. Pass = three yes answers, under a minute per seed.
